description: US Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Other, U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT). The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) manages the Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS), a database of the United States highway system. HPMS provides data on the extent, condition, performance, use, and operating characteristics of the nation's highways. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: JSON. Size stated: 2. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0.
